user.title: Create a Better To-do list

set_task_recurrence.name: Set task recurrence
set_task_recurrence.description: Sets or clears an iCalendar RRULE recurrence rule on a specific task. When a recurring task is completed it automatically advances to the next due date.

item.name: Task UID
item.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the task to update.

rrule.name: RRULE
rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE string (e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO'). Omit or leave blank to remove recurrence.

set_task_details.name: Set task details
set_task_details.description: Sets quantity, category and/or notes on a specific task, stored inside the description field so they are visible in the standard HA Tasks panel.

item.name: Task UID
item.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the task to update.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Free-text quantity string (e.g. '2 kg'). Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category label for the task (e.g. 'Meat'). Omit to leave the existing value unchanged.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text notes to attach to the task. Omit to leave the existing notes unchanged.
